text:
Ryan Leonard is one of the best young stories in Washington, and he's on a six-game point streak to prove it (5 goals, 3 assists). The 2023 eighth overall pick has 10 goals in 22 games at 21, playing just over 14 minutes a night, and his 0.86 points a game is more than double the median first full season for forwards drafted where he was.

Some of the goal total is hot finishing. He's scoring on 16% of his shots against 13% last season, and our numbers have him 3.3 goals ahead of his chances. But the chances are real: 61 shots, a shot that NHL EDGE clocks in the 96th percentile for speed, and 8 power-play points.

The part to watch is the defensive side. Washington has been out-chanced with him on the ice, and Evolving-Hockey had him in the bottom 9% of forwards for chances allowed last season. A Capitals team that has lost seven of its last ten will keep feeding a 21-year-old who scores, but bigger minutes will depend on that.
